page.overview:
Who is Sergeant?

Sergeant is a minor character of the Special Forces that briefly appears in Mortal Kombat X and is a playable character in Mortal Kombat Mobile.

The Sergeant is a grizzled-looking Special Forces member, wearing a dark gray urban camo jumpsuit, black combat gloves, a black, bulky Kevlar vest with numerous ammo pouches placed on the front with a walkie talkie on the top left of the vest, a duty belt on his waist, two holsters with pistols in them on his thighs and black combat boots.

He has brown hair applied into a crew cut.

A character with an appearance identical to Sergeant's appears in the Mortal Kombat X Story Mode and is seen piloting a helicopter carrying other soldiers along with Johnny Cage, Sonya Blade and Kenshi during the Netherrealm invasion of Earthrealm. He is ultimately killed after Scorpion throws his kunai straight into the character's head, piercing through their face. It is unknown whether or not this is the same character featured in Mortal Kombat Mobile.
